location.label: Southern California
location.detail: Working remotely as a freelance AI consultant and developer.

building.title: Verso
building.note: A diary for artworks, built on the bet that logging individual works instead of gallery visits is what makes the habit stick.

building.title: Cocoon and Feedless
building.note: Two browser extensions aimed at the same problem from different angles: giving people back control of what a page does to their attention.

building.title: unlinkd
building.note: Encrypted, local-only evidence keeping for data-broker removal, because the hard part of disappearing is proving you asked.

building.title: The repo fleet
building.note: Roughly seventy repositories run by scheduled agents that open pull requests rather than pushing. I review a queue instead of seventy inboxes.

thinkingAbout: Whether self-hosting is a technical preference or a political one, and what changes if it is the second.
How much of what gets called productivity is really just legibility to someone else.
Tools that degrade gracefully when the company behind them disappears.
Why the interesting part of a recommendation system is what it refuses to show you.
